payload.claim: In the `result` branch of `_describe_agent_event`, `event.get('num_turns')` and `event.get('total_cost_usd')` are interpolated straight into the returned line without going through `_scrub`, unlike every other field in the same branch (`subtype`, `terminal_reason`) and every other branch. These two fields come from the same untrusted `event` dict the docstring two lines above claims is fully covered ("nothing else here is host-authored, so nothing else is exempt") — a compromised or malformed cell process sharing the runner's stdout (per the `Agent` kind's own docstring) can forge a `result`-shaped line whose `num_turns` or `total_cost_usd` is a string carrying the same kind of ESC/BEL sequence the spec exists to neutralize, and it will reach the rendered line and `saffron watch`'s terminal unscrubbed. The added tests only exercise `subtype`/`terminal_reason` with long strings and always pass numeric `num_turns`/`total_cost_usd`, so this gap is invisible to the gate suite.
